name: Hypixel
desc: The biggest Minecraft network in the world and the reference for minigames. Dozens of polished modes, from BedWars and SkyWars to the massive Hypixel SkyBlock MMO-style grind. If you only try one server, try this one.

name: Wynncraft
desc: A full MMORPG built inside Minecraft: handcrafted world, thousands of quests, classes, dungeons and boss fights. The closest thing to a standalone RPG you can play for free on a server.

name: MCC Island
desc: The public server from the creators of the MC Championship event. Fast, competitive party games with cosmetics and a battle pass. Enable server resource packs when joining.

name: CubeCraft
desc: One of the strongest Hypixel alternatives, and one of the few big networks that runs on both Java and Bedrock. Competitive minigames, seasonal events and a very active PvP community.

name: The Hive
desc: The classic Bedrock minigame network. Quick, friendly party games with instant matchmaking - the easiest way to play with friends on console or mobile.

name: Complex Gaming
desc: The reference network for modded Minecraft, famous for its Pixelmon servers (Pokemon inside Minecraft). Needs the matching modpack; check their site for the launcher.

name: PikaNetwork
desc: One of the most active community networks, welcoming non-premium accounts. Classic modes with heavy economies and constant events.

name: 2b2t
players: hundreds online, long queue at peak
desc: The oldest anarchy server in Minecraft: no rules, no resets, a decade of ruins and player history. Hardcore and not for beginners - expect a queue, griefing and total freedom.
